note: Horses promoted out of the source DB's P1-SEED pool into the playable roster. The build treats these exactly like P0 rows — stats, role, distance and skill are all still derived from horse-game-db.json — so the only hand-authored fields here are the ones a derivation cannot supply: which cost bracket the unit occupies, and the running style when it is a design decision rather than a reading of the record.
policy: Every addition states its cost and its style with a reason. `styleMatchesSource` is false when the declared style disagrees with the horse's own historySummary.primaryStyle in horse-game-db.json; that is allowed, but it is never silent — the field and the reason are what make it auditable. The style evidence file (running-style-evidence.json) is generated from a passage database that is not committed, so additions carry no evidence row and must not claim one. nameEn is supplied here because the seed rows carry no English name, and the unit id — which every art file is named after — is derived from it.
